area_basis: county area; differs from published agricultural-area intersection
calendar_assignment_rule: retain each map in its own map-date calendar year, plus the preceding map carried by the first query when it covers 2001-01-01

contract.interpretation: historical county-area approximation for October-through-September external validation; never projected as future USDM or used directly as an SCC input

source_corrections.reason: single source-row arithmetic anomaly among the source files; raw response remains unchanged and checksummed
source_corrections.rule: renormalize six exclusive category percentages to sum to 100
